cmo-cmo-2003-01.prompt: Consider a standard twelve-hour clock whose hour and minute hands move continuously. Let $m$ be an integer, with $1 \le m \le 720$. At precisely $m$ minutes after 12:00, the angle made by the hour hand and minute hand is exactly $1^\circ$. Determine all possible values of $m$.

cmo-cmo-2003-02.prompt: Find the last three digits of the number $2003^{2002^{2001}}$.

cmo-cmo-2003-03.prompt:
Find all real positive solutions (if any) to
$$x^3 + y^3 + z^3 = x + y + z, \quad\text{and}$$
$$x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = xyz.$$

cmo-cmo-2003-04.prompt: Prove that when three circles share the same chord $AB$, every line through $A$ different from $AB$ determines the same ratio $XY : YZ$, where $X$ is an arbitrary point different from $B$ on the first circle while $Y$ and $Z$ are the points where $AX$ intersects the other two circles (labelled so that $Y$ is between $X$ and $Z$).
cmo-cmo-2003-04.answer: Project the centres (all on the perpendicular bisector of $AB$) onto the line: $AX$, $AY$, $AZ$ are twice the projections, so $XY : YZ = O_1O_2 : O_2O_3$ for every line.

cmo-cmo-2003-05.prompt: Let $S$ be a set of $n$ points in the plane such that any two points of $S$ are at least $1$ unit apart. Prove there is a subset $T$ of $S$ with at least $n/7$ points such that any two points of $T$ are at least $\sqrt3$ units apart.
cmo-cmo-2003-05.answer: Greedily take the highest remaining point and delete everything within $\sqrt3$ of it; the deleted points lie in a lower half-annulus $1 \le \rho < \sqrt3$, which splits into six $30^\circ$ sectors of diameter $< 1$, so each step deletes at most $7$ points.
